_about.purpose: Ground-state nuclear properties: half-life, decay modes, natural abundance, spin and parity, mass excess.
_about.generated_by: tools/build_nuclide_table.py -- do not hand-edit; re-run it
_about.ground_states_only: NUBASE also carries isomers (T-half >= 100 ns); they are NOT here. A molfile cannot express Tc-99m as distinct from Tc-99, so isomer rows would be data nothing in this application could reach. 3557 ground states kept, 2127 isomer rows skipped, and the free neutron (Z=0) with them -- it is not an element.
_about.abundance_means: Natural terrestrial isotopic abundance, as a percentage -- NUBASE's IS= field. Not cosmic abundance, not a share of all known isotopes.
_about.half_life_has_two_dimensions: `seconds` and `qualifier` describe the VALUE; `uncertainty_s` and `uncertainty_qualifier` describe its uncertainty, independently. A row can be an estimated value beside a measured bound. Where the value is absent and dT holds a bound, that bound IS the value.
